<subject>Re: Performance Review and Compensation</subject>
<body>
This is basically how it was handled last year, except they are splitting Investment and Asset Management.  Regarding Portfolio Coordinators - we need to provide them the bonus targets rather than Investor Relations just deciding.  Regarding non-portfolio - again, we need to provide the targets (as we discussed earlier this week).

The biggest issue we have is how to use Cedar Point's Performance Management System (PMS) and avoid the manual excel spreadsheet-PMS-excel spreadsheet exercise we went through last year.  We are working with Hannah Ferguson and the PMS team on this.  

VP's have to go through the final Cedar Point-wide review, so that is one more step for the VP's and the Deal Team meeting outcome should be consistent with how all are rated going into the final meeting (ie., 10/80/10, 1-100).

Jennifer Miller, Counsel
Cedar Point Capital Partners
1301 East Boulevard, Charlotte, NC 28203
Phone: 704-555-1234
</body>

-----Original Message-----
From:  Davis, Matthew  
Sent: Tuesday, October 14, 2025 1:17 PM
To: Smith, Brandy
Subject: Performance Review and Compensation

Here is our plan on Cedar Point's review process.

Portfolio Coordinators:

Ranked 1,2,3 by supervisors - pay determined by Me and Brandy.  No meetings.

Non-portfolio but in Asset Management:

Traditional ranking with the correct people attending the meetings.  Pay grid determined by Investor Relations.

Analysts and Associates

Ranked as per Cameron Lemmons' percentages and then pay grid determined by Investor Relations
I would like to see 25% - 65% - 10%.  Cameron disagrees.  This would provide for a quick meeting rather than trying to split them into 4 groups with the top one excluding some awesome people.

Managers/Directors

Ranked from 1 to 100 in as many clusters as the groups see fit.  We are going to combine managers and directors into one table.  The ranking is based on this year's performance and is directly related to pay.  We will have two meetings - one for investment staff and one for other asset management staff (orig/finance/etc).  We will not have a pay prc but will take the results of the rankings and work with individual leaders after the meetings to ensure the appropriate compensation.

We will also determine promotions during this meeting using different criteria.

VP's

We will rank all our VP's from 1 to 100 with a group of selected people - some VP's and some MD's.  
This too will be directly related to pay.

Cheers
</quoted>
